args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and tests
(tests/test_money.py) expect banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
as required by FIN-212. Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py#round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the documented banker's rounding behavior required by FIN-212.
- This fixes the nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expected banker's rounding.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
